target.scope: Observed Windows x64 v11 console preprocessor; mesh import fixtures exercise 3D, and startup fixtures exercise default, PRE3, PRE and MULTI paths

initialization: Root initialization sets material and main object counts to zero and initializes their collections.
The console constructor 0x14001c770 constructs two root-state instances and two DB-related instances, then connects the root states using 0x1401d8000.
The alternate root pointer is at +0x33e8. Keyword parser target helper 0x1401d81b0 returns it only when it is nonnull and +0x33f0 is enabled; otherwise it returns the current root.
Both root constructors receive dimension 3. Linking through 0x1401d8000/0x1401d8050 changes the secondary root to dimension 2; the completed console context has primary 3 and secondary 2.

Startup configuration is processed before the first menu: DEF_MULTI.INI takes precedence and exits after keyword processing; otherwise DEF_PRE3.INI precedes DEF_PRE.INI. The PRE-only fixture changes the primary dimension to 2 while the secondary stays 2. The roots are therefore not universally complementary.

Without startup files, both root collections are empty at the first menu. PRE3 and PRE fixtures create object 1 before that menu. Constructor state and configured first-menu state must be represented as distinct phases.

Alternate-model routing during general imports and dimension changes with existing meshes remain unverified. Startup evidence is recorded in startup-existing-evidence.json and startup-observations.json.
Ordinary keyword import is not a call to the full root initializer. The observed second import preserved existing object identity and fields omitted from the file.

An existing ID returns the existing object.

sequence: Optionally clear two per-import flags through 0x1401d7f10; this does not clear the model.
Record current filename, open file and set import option flags.
Read tokens sequentially; detect dimension from recognized header comments.
Resolve exact keyword spelling and handler category, select current or alternate root, and dispatch immediately.

keyword_table.warning: 304 table entries is not a claim of 304 distinct implemented keywords.

finalization: Calls a simulation-control routine at 0x1401ee510, whose complete meaning remains unresolved.
0x1401d6250 traverses material references and adjusts referenced records.
0x1401d63c0 visits non-inactive objects and calls 0x1402059a0, which conditionally performs geometry-related calculations and classifications.
Updates step-related fields if the corresponding import flag was set.
The observed truncated-coordinate import ran finalization and retained partial state.
import_lifecycle.commands: DBREAD, KFREAD and GENDB are confirmed table entries in the special-handler category. The first invokes the DB importer; the second can recursively read another keyword file. Complete command behavior and effects are outside this milestone.

coordinates.behavior: The old coordinate buffer is freed and nulled, then a zero-initialized double buffer is allocated through 0x140257150/calloc for a positive count. Dependent node buffers are also processed. The handler fills rows sequentially.
coordinates.dependent_default: 0x1401652b0 sets a dependent double array at +0x8e0 to20.0 or68.0 according to the unit predicate. Runtime observed20.0; the68.0 branch has not been exercised.

connectivity.behavior: The old connectivity buffer is freed and nulled, then zero-initialized integers are allocated through 0x140256dc0/calloc. Reuse of the same numerical address does not imply preservation of the old allocation.
connectivity.dependent_defaults: Dependent arrays include +0xa30 set to1.0 and +0xa38 set to0.0. Their domain meanings are not asserted.

array_ownership.qualification: The subsequent mesh-array-contract.json maps all 28 node and 25 element registered state variables and the direct-buffer paths. Default 3D bulk replacement is runtime-validated, and the internal C++ state-variable component passes captured-state replay. Sharing, nondefault controls, 2D paths and complete object ownership remain partial.

validation.scope: Two fresh original processes, fourteen sequential imports of twelve small synthetic 3D fixtures, passive memory observation only
validation.excluded: No exhaustive keyword coverage, complete object layout, 2D mesh-import validation, solver validation, or replacement implementation.

startup.scope: Four fresh original processes suspended at creation, passive hooks installed before primary-thread resume; constructor, context and configured state observations
startup.qualification: Selected controls and all 79 component counts are captured. Observed offset values do not establish the meaning or initialization provenance of every field.

implementation_gate.decision: Do not yet present this partial specification as a complete recreated application model.
remaining_questions: Recover complete ownership and defaults of node/element dependent fields before replacing their allocation behavior.
Explain and validate post-connectivity derived-state calculation at0x1401fc290 and the geometry-related finalization path with nontrivial fixtures.
Recover alternate-model routing and dimension changes, including their interaction with existing objects.
Recover material/object reference invariants before adding those domains.
Exercise remaining order, count-change, whitespace, missing-value and error cases before declaring a keyword subset compatible.
Separate observed deterministic legacy behavior from unsafe or undefined cases; do not silently invent a policy.
implementation_gate.next_boundary: A source-backed object identity/name/type and mesh import contract, including allocation side effects and finalization, followed by a C++ implementation only where this contract is established.
